title: EggSpawn Scrambled
description: This makes it possible to acquire Mob Spawners and Spawn Eggs in Survival Minecraft.
body:
EggSpawn Scrambled is a very basic mod, that adds the ability to acquire mob spawners and spawn eggs in survival mode.

![Mob Spawner Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d220ee92d3cf09d8cce98ca81c91d3ea13d2e68d.png)

It adds Purpur infused eggs, "Spawner Eggs", and an Egg Scrambler.

Use the spawner tears to right click on and charge an Egg Scrambler. To use an egg scrambler, you need a Dragon Egg in the purple slot, eggs in the top left slot, various recipes for mobs in the two slots, and your egg will craft into the red slot.
